system.specialAbility:
You become Trained in Crafting and Medicine, and you become Trained in a relevant Lore of your choice.

Example Lores include Herbalism Lore, Alchemy Lore, Toxicology Lore.
system.description: You prepared remedies and useful mixtures, learning how much depended on clean tools and careful measures. Customers brought you their complaints, and sometimes problems they were afraid to take elsewhere.
